title: Pick your first AI video route in 10 minutes
desc: Four questions decide your route: what you want to make, who appears, how long, and whether you will pay. Do not start with a model; start with a deliverable.
text: EN02 Start here start Starter path Pick your first AI video route in 10 minutes Starter route Four questions decide your route: what you want to make, who appears, how long, and whether you will pay. Do not start with a model; start with a deliverable. Choose one route for the next 7 days and write down what you will NOT do. One route card: deliverable, length, tools, budget, deadline, kill criteria. 10 minutes ¥0 Beginner You want to test five models at once. Pick one route first. One concrete deliverable, not 'learn AI video'. A deadline within 7 days. A budget ceiling you can afford to lose. A machine you actually have (phone / 8GB laptop / 16GB GPU / cloud). Four questions, in order Question If yes If no Do you need a person on camera? Talking head / drama / character route Product / landscape / mood route Do you need a story with multiple shots? Drama route: script > storyboard > shots Short route: one hook, one shot Do you need exact product/label text? Shoot or use H3/Seedance plus post typography Pure AI generation Can you spend ¥100–300 this week? Cloud-first, 1080p, more retries Local 5B / free tiers, lower resolution Three routes Route Best for First output Avoid A. Drama (90s) Story, 2 characters, 16 shots 15s proof scene, then 90s Starting with a 10-minute film B. Short-form Product, talking head, 15s hook One 15s vertical video Copying viral edits without a hook C. Brand / mood MV, travel, atmosphere One 5s hero shot + one 15s cut No narrative, only pretty frames Seven-day plan Day Do Done when 1 Write one sentence + one reference You can say what 'done' looks like 2 Install one editor + one generator You can export a 5s clip 3 Generate 5 shots, keep 1 You know your failure rate 4 Add voice / music / subtitles You can watch it on a phone 5 Reshoot or regenerate the weakest shot One shot improves, not all 6 Export and QC 12-point check passes 7 Publish privately, write 5 lines You know cost and next fix Kill criteria If three attempts on the same shot fail for the same reason, change the shot design, not the model. If the whole route misses the deadline twice, cut scope: 90s to 30s, 16 shots to 6. Do not extend the deadline silently. Answer the four questions in one line each. Pick route A, B or C; write why. Write the deliverable, length, aspect ratio and deadline. List the exact tools you will use, no more than three. Set a budget ceiling and a retry cap. Write three kill criteria. Put the route card where you will see it. Route card Deliverable: ____ Length / ratio: ____ Audience / platform: ____ Route: A drama / B short / C brand Tools (max 3): ____ Budget ceiling: ¥____ Retry cap per shot: ____ Deadline: ____ Kill criteria: ____ You can name one route, not three. Deliverable has a length and a platform. Tool list has no more than three tools. Budget and retry cap are written down. Kill criteria are specific. title: ComfyUI for video: install order, first 5s, and when to stop
desc: ComfyUI is a node-based local studio. It is not required to make AI video; it is required when you want repeatability, privacy, or no per-second cost. If you have less than 16GB VRAM, do not start here.
text: EN21 Tools & models knowledge Tool guide ComfyUI for video: install order, first 5s, and when to stop ComfyUI ComfyUI is a node-based local studio. It is not required to make AI video; it is required when you want repeatability, privacy, or no per-second cost. If you have less than 16GB VRAM, do not start here. desc: 15 seconds is not a shortened ad. It is one hook, one demo, one payoff. Generate 3 shots, keep 1, add a human voice and phone-readable captions.
text: EN12 Short-form short Task guide Your first 15-second vertical video First 15s 15 seconds is not a shortened ad. It is one hook, one demo, one payoff. text: EN27 Fix & deliver fix Delivery guide Export, platform specs and 12-point QC Export & QC A video is not done when it looks good in the editor. It is done when it uploads, reads on a phone, and the captions do not cover a face. Run 12 checks before you publish. Export a platform-ready file and pass 12 QC checks. title: AI lab: three demo recipes + a 10-second tool picker
desc: A demo is not a fake finished film. It is a shot sheet you can actually run. Three recipes are broken into timed beats; four questions return a tool stack. No real footage, no decorative images.
text: EN29 Tools & models knowledge Interactive lab AI lab: three demo recipes + a 10-second tool picker AI lab A demo is not a fake finished film. It is a shot sheet you can actually run. Three recipes are broken into timed beats; four questions return a tool stack. No real footage, no decorative images. See how a film is structured, then pick three tools for your hardware and budget. One recipe timeline + one three-tool stack + one first-test record. 10–40 minutes ¥0 Beginner You want one-click finished video. This gives recipes, order and checks, not generation. Read `/en/start/route/`, or already have a defined deliverable. Know your GPU / cloud credit / monthly budget; if not, pick the lowest tier. Prepare a log: model, length, resolution, time, cost, failure type. Three demos: structure first, not the highlight reel This is not model footage and not a rendered still. It is three shot recipes you can run: time, shot size, action, model, sound and prompt core on one timeline. “Play shot strip” only walks the timeline and highlights cards. It does not play video; it is for pacing, not proof of model quality. 90s drama 15s product 30s talking head Play shot strip 01:30 / 01:30 timeline demo · not video playback Output 16-shot list + 90s MP4 + SRT Time 2–5 days Budget ¥150–500 / episode 00:00–00:08 01 The voice note Close / phone screen Phone fills one third of the frame; thumb hovers, does not play. Model：H3 / Seedance Sound：Room tone + notification Prompt core Phone fills 1/3; thumb hovers; do not play; locked-off. 00:08–00:18 02 First callback Medium / hand Thumb hits callback; cut to the hallway outside. Model：Kling 4.0 / Seedance Sound：Low heartbeat Prompt core Thumb hits callback; cut to hallway; medium. 00:18–00:30 03 Someone outside Wide / door Door opens a crack; hall light flickers; no face. Model：Kling 4.0 Sound：Lock + footsteps Prompt core Door ajar; hall light flickers; no face. 00:30–00:42 04 Turn Close / face She hears her own voice, but the line is from the future. Model：H3 Sound：Overlapping voice Prompt core Close face; her own line, but from the future. 00:42–00:54 05 The cost Insert / clock Each callback costs ten minutes; only clock and hand. Model：H3 Sound：Ticking Prompt core Clock and hand; ten minutes gone; insert. 00:54–01:08 06 The decision Medium / hallway She walks to the door; follow her back, no face. Model：Kling 4.0 Sound：Steps + breath Prompt core Follow her back to the door; no face. 01:08–01:20 07 Climax Two-shot close Two voices speak at once; only one face on screen. Model：Seedance 2.5 Sound：Dual dialogue Prompt core One face; two voices at once; close. 01:20–01:30 08 Out Close / black Phone goes black; silence outside; hold two seconds. Model：H3 Sound：Two seconds of silence Prompt core Phone black; silence; two-second black hold. Output 3-shot product film + cover + SRT Time 2–3 hours Budget ¥20–80 00:00–00:03 01 Label macro Macro / label Label fills half the frame; hand enters; hold 0.5s. Model：H3 / Seedance Sound：No music; keep room tone Prompt core Label fills 1/2; hand enters; macro. 00:03–00:08 02 Hand in frame Medium / use One action: lift, open, pour; one selling point only. Model：Seedance 2.5 Sound：Fabric / bottle foley Prompt core Lift, open, pour; one action; medium. 00:08–00:15 03 Payoff Close / result Result on a clean background; leave caption safe area. Model：H3 Sound：One VO line + light music Prompt core Result on clean background; caption safe area right. Output 30s talking head + SRT + cover Time 1–2 hours Budget ¥10–50 00:00–00:05 01 Hook Close / front First line is the result, not an introduction. Model：HeyGen / Hedra Sound：VO first Prompt core Front close; first line is the result; no reading. 00:05–00:20 02 Proof Medium / demo One verifiable action or screen result; do not cut five angles. Model：Hedra / H3 Sound：VO + room tone Prompt core One verifiable action or screen result. 00:20–00:30 03 Close Close / CTA One action line; leave caption space; no logo animation. Model：HeyGen Sound：VO lands Prompt core One CTA; caption space; no logo animation. 10-second tool picker: four questions, three cards Pick the deliverable, then hardware and budget, then priority. The result is not “the best”; it is what to run first, what to keep as backup, and what to avoid under these conditions. Change one variable at a time. Run 5s, 720p, three takes on the same prompt before 1080p/4K or 30s. Deliverable 90s drama 15s short Product film Talking head Brand / mood Hardware No GPU / cloud only 16GB GPU 24GB or more Monthly budget ¥0–100 ¥100–500 ¥500+ Priority Speed Control / local Native audio Directions, not a leaderboard. Prices, quotas and access follow the official pages.
